clusters.headline: Albania: As corruption cases multiply, experts question whether the anti-corruption drive is addressing the causes or just the symptoms.
clusters.summary: From a former president to the ex-intelligence chief, Albania is prosecuting senior officials at a rate once thought impossible. But do more prosecutions mean less corruption or simply better enforcement?

clusters.headline: North Korea has recently completed two road bridges easing transport to strategic allies Russia and China
clusters.summary: Two recently opened bridges are expected to ease trade and transport between North Korea and its powerful neighbors. The new connections come as Pyongyang builds strategic ties with China and Russia.

clusters.summary: This comes after a religious influencer sexually abused two young brothers, including one at a mosque, while on bail for another offence.
